intent.purpose: Record when things happened and what was documented for a suspected snake bite, so that process measures can be described for local review.
intent.setting: Any care setting that sees people with a suspected snake bite. Narrowing is for the local clinician to declare.
intent.population: People presenting with a suspected snake bite. No narrower scope is assumed.
exclusions: Diagnosis, severity grading and treatment choice.
Any product, quantity or amount of anything given.
intent.rationale: Time and documentation questions can be asked without any clinical number, which lets the whole chain be shown without one.

fields.label: Time of the bite
constraints: The effective time and the recorded time are both carried by the record, each with its time zone state.
Often only an estimate. An estimate must stay visible as an estimate.

fields.label: How certain the bite time is

mapping.note: Demonstration code in a local demonstration code system. Unverified. Not a real terminology code.

constraints: A value means the stated certainty (exact or estimated). Not known is the state unknown. It is never inferred from the bite time.

fields.label: Time of arrival at the facility
constraints: The effective time and the recorded time are both carried by the record, each with its time zone state.
If absent, nothing downstream may assume it.

fields.label: Clotting test status

mapping.note: Demonstration code in a local demonstration code system. Unverified. Not a real terminology code.

constraints: A value means the test is documented as performed. Explicitly not performed is the state explicitly-negative. Unknown is the state unknown. No entry at all is the state absent. These are never merged.

fields.label: Time the clotting test was started
constraints: The effective time and the recorded time are both carried by the record, each with its time zone state.
Applicable only when the clotting test status says performed. Otherwise it is not applicable.

fields.label: Time the clotting test result was read
constraints: The effective time and the recorded time are both carried by the record, each with its time zone state.
This is the time the result was read, not the time it was typed in.

fields.label: Result of the clotting test

mapping.note: Demonstration code in a local demonstration code system. Unverified. Not a real terminology code.

constraints: A result that was not read is a missing-data state, never a result value.

fields.label: Anti-snake-venom administration status

mapping.note: Demonstration code in a local demonstration code system. Unverified. Not a real terminology code.

constraints: A value means the agent is documented as given. Explicitly not given is the state explicitly-negative. Unknown is the state unknown. No entry at all is the state absent. These are never merged.

fields.label: Time anti-snake-venom administration began
constraints: The effective time and the recorded time are both carried by the record, each with its time zone state.
The start of the first administration. Applicable only when the status says given. Otherwise it is not applicable.

fields.label: Reason anti-snake-venom was not given

mapping.note: Demonstration code in a local demonstration code system. Unverified. Not a real terminology code.

constraints: Optional. Applicable only when the status says explicitly not given.

provenance.basis: Facts F1 to F9 of the use-case dossier. Demonstration only. No clinical review has taken place and no clinician owner is named.
